proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Everything follows formally from the commutative double restriction diagram with both squares cartesian written in the statement of the double-restrict lemma. Forward direction: the image of h'' is contained in the image of h because g'' = g composed with g', so the lower right corner U of the diagram may be replaced by h(U' x_U R), making conditions (1) and (2) the statement that the diagram lives over a tau-covering of that image; the cartesian squares then exhibit h'' as a base change composition through h', and base change preservation of P gives h'' has P. Converse direction: h' equals the composition of pr_0 : U' x_{g,U,t} R to U' with the pullback structure; pr_0 is a tau-covering as a base change of the tau-covering t : R to U of condition (a), so tau-locality on the target descends the property P from h'' to h'. (source lines 1104-1114)
